basic_info.description: Location! Location! Location! You won't want to miss this stunning penthouse level condominium in a 4 unit building, each with a private entrance. Period details blend beautifully with modern finishes to create the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. Upon entering, one is greeted by an open floor plan and walls of windows bathing the home in abundant natural light. A hallway takes you to the large and stunning primary suite which includes: a sitting/dressing area, full bath, a working fireplace and an expansive South-facing deck with views. This is truly a special private retreat!  Along the hall, you will find another bedroom and full bath.    Walk to shops and restaurants on Sacrament and Fillmore or head to Alta Plaza Park, or The Presidio.  And, if you're a flower lover, Bloomers Florist is a few doors away!  This lovely block in Pacific Heights is the perfect location to enjoy city living as well as nature and the great outdoors!  You won't want to miss this one!
